blocks.text: Transform your outdoor living space with the Clare View lounge chair, designed for both comfort and durability. Crafted from eucalyptus wood, this chair features a sleek slat design and tapered details that bring timeless style to your patio or deck. The frame is treated with a 5-step protective finish, offering enhanced resistance to the elements so you can enjoy worry-free outdoor lounging season after season. Plush, zippered cushions are wrapped in high-performing Nuvella fabric that resists fading and stains, making maintenance simple—just clean with mild soap and water or a bleach solution for tougher spots. Inside, an all-weather foam core ensures lasting comfort, while the soft polyester wrap adds a touch of luxury. Perfect for relaxing poolside, on a balcony, or in a backyard retreat, this outdoor lounge chair combines elegance and practicality for any outdoor setting. Assembly required.
